info.title: Sanr API
info.description:
API v2 documentation.

Current Santiment Score API routes are served under `/v2/...`.

Compatibility aliases:
- `/v1/...` mirrors the current API during rollout.
- Legacy prod-compatible endpoints stay under `/v1/...`.

Standard query parser for current list endpoints:
- take: required integer 1..500
- skip: optional integer offset
- sort: comma separated field:direction list, e.g. createdAt:desc,verifiedAt:asc
- filter: JSON object content without outer braces, e.g. "status":"active"
- attributes: comma separated quoted list, e.g. "id","asset","status"

Filter operators supported:
$ne, $gte, $gt, $lte, $lt, $notIn, $iLike, $ilike, $between, $notBetween, $and, $or

Filter examples (URL-encode them when sending):
- Exact match: filter="asset":"BTC"
- Range: filter="entryPrice":{"$gte":1000,"$lt":50000}
- OR: filter="$or":[{"asset":"BTC"},{"asset":"ETH"}]
- AND + iLike: filter="$and":[{"status":"active"},{"description":{"$iLike":"%breakout%"}}]
- Between dates: filter="createdAt":{"$between":["2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z","2026-02-01T00:00:00.000Z"]}

get.description: List current user predictions (supports queryParser)

triggerPrice.description: Optional. When provided the prediction is created as a pending order (status 'created') and is opened automatically once the real price crosses triggerPrice in the direction set by openWhenPriceMoreThen. Must be a positive number.

openWhenPriceMoreThen.description: Only used together with triggerPrice. true → open when current price >= triggerPrice; false (default) → open when current price <= triggerPrice.

filter.name: filter
filter.description: JSON object content without outer braces. Example: "$or":[{"asset":"BTC"},{"asset":"ETH"}]

attributes.name: attributes
attributes.description: Quoted field list for DB attributes. Example: "id","asset","status"

kolPerformance.description: Direction-adjusted percentage return of the KOL's signal: (resolvePrice - entryPrice) / entryPrice for 'up', negated for 'down'. Null until market resolves.

status.description: 'created' is a pending order awaiting its triggerPrice; 'open' is an active prediction; 'closed' is resolved; 'expired' is a pending order whose market voting closed before it triggered.

openPrice.description: Null while status is 'created' (not yet opened).

triggerPrice.description: Trigger level of a pending ('created') prediction. It opens at the first real price that crosses this level (openPrice is that price, not necessarily triggerPrice). Null for predictions opened immediately.

openWhenPriceMoreThen.description: For pending predictions: true → open when price >= triggerPrice; false → open when price <= triggerPrice.

beatKOL.description: market.kolPerformance minus prediction.performance for this specific prediction. Null until both the market has resolved (kolPerformance set) and the prediction is closed.

v.description: Running cumulative PnL rounded to 2 decimal places

date.description: closeDate of the prediction (falls back to openDate if closeDate is null)

PredictionMerkleProofItem.description: Prediction in ERC-712 format with merkle proof — matches the IPFS signalData shape

marketPredictionUpPercent.description: Percentage of this issuer's market predictions (all-time) that have direction 'up' (0–100). Updated when a prediction is opened.

beatKOLs.description: SUM(market.kolPerformance) - SUM(prediction.performance) across all closed predictions where the market has a resolved kolPerformance.

marketPredictionAvgPerfClosed.description: Average leverage-adjusted performance (performance * leverage) across ALL of this issuer's closed market predictions. Recomputed whenever a prediction closes.

marketPredictionAvgPerfClosedPositive.description: Average leverage-adjusted performance across this issuer's closed market predictions whose leveraged performance is positive (winners only). Recomputed whenever a prediction closes.

marketPredictionAvgPerfClosedNegative.description: Average leverage-adjusted performance across this issuer's closed market predictions whose leveraged performance is negative (losers only). Recomputed whenever a prediction closes.
